# Stone lantern (toro): a plinth, a post, a fire box with glowing windows, a wide pyramid roof and
# a knob. 1.2 x 1.2 x 2.5 m, origin on the ground. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.1451 0.3020 0.4392 --no-slot
material new Fire --base-color 0.9882 0.9647 0.3765 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Plinth --vertices 6 --radius 0.6 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 0.15
add mesh cylinder --name Post --vertices 6 --radius 0.22 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name Shelf --vertices 6 --radius 0.55 --depth 0.18 --location 0 0 1.27
add mesh cone --name Roof --vertices 6 --radius1 0.85 --radius2 0.18 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 2.06
add mesh ico-sphere --name Knob --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.17 --location 0 0 2.38
select Plinth Post Shelf Roof Knob
active Plinth
join
rename Plinth Lantern
material assign Stone
add mesh cube --name Box --size 1 --location 0 0 1.58
scale 0.66 0.66 0.46
apply --scale
material assign Fire
add mesh cube --name Pillars --size 1 --location 0 0 1.58
scale 0.78 0.3 0.46
apply --scale
material assign Stone
add mesh cube --name Pillars2 --size 1 --location 0 0 1.58
scale 0.3 0.78 0.46
apply --scale
material assign Stone
select all
shade flat
export lantern.glb
